name: City Hotel
signature_dish: Kerala meals served on banana leaf, plus kuruma and biryani
why_it_matters: One of the oldest restaurants in Kollam, serving the town since 1960. City Hotel does authentic South Indian and Kerala-style food — kuruma, mutton curry, biryani and meals on banana leaf — at budget prices, and is the address locals point to for traditional, no-frills Quilon cooking.
insider_tip: Open long hours (around 8am to nearly midnight), so it works for an early breakfast or a late dinner. Order the banana-leaf meals at lunch for the most authentic plate. Cash and UPI.

name: Quilon Lunch Home
signature_dish: Kerala fish-meals — netholi (anchovy) fry and choora (tuna) curry
why_it_matters: A no-frills lunch-only place near Chinnakada serving homely Kerala seafood meals — netholi (anchovy) fry and thoran, choora (tuna) curry, kaka thoran — at very affordable prices. Reviewers come for an honest, home-style Kerala fish lunch, the kind of place locals rate for the meals rather than the surroundings.
insider_tip: Lunch only — it runs roughly midday to 4pm and shuts. Go for the fish meals; the netholi fry is the standout. It is a low-budget, basic room with no parking, best treated as a quick local lunch stop.
signature_address: Quilon Lunch Home, Kollam-Chengotta Road, Chinnakada, Kollam, Kerala 691001

name: Indian Coffee House
signature_dish: Filter coffee and South Indian breakfast at the cooperative chain
why_it_matters: The Kollam branch of the worker-cooperative Indian Coffee House, near the KSRTC bus stand at Chinnakada. The ICH society runs over fifty Kerala branches; the Chinnakada outlet is a long-running everyday institution for cheap South Indian breakfast and the chain's signature filter coffee.
insider_tip: Handy as a budget breakfast or coffee stop near the bus stand, useful before catching the Kollam-Alleppey backwater ferry. Order the mutton cutlet with filter coffee. Cash preferred.
signature_address: Indian Coffee House, Archana Aradhana Complex, near KSRTC Stand, Chinnakada, Kollam, Kerala 691001

name: Wok & Grill at The Quilon Beach Hotel
signature_dish: Asian grills and stir-fries at Kollam's seafront five-star hotel
why_it_matters: The specialty restaurant of The Quilon Beach Hotel & Convention Centre — a five-star hotel right on Kollam Beach with Arabian Sea views. Wok & Grill is Kollam's go-to for a fine-dining evening: Asian grills, stir-fries and kebabs in a calm, comfortable room, a contrast to the town's budget meals places.
insider_tip: The most upmarket dining option in Kollam — book ahead. Service can be slow, so allow time. The calamari and grilled dishes are the picks; pair with the seafront setting at sunset.
signature_address: The Quilon Beach Hotel, Kollam Beach, Kollam, Kerala 691001

name: Bismi Hotel
signature_dish: Chicken biryani and Malabar-style non-veg dishes
why_it_matters: An everyday family restaurant in the Pallimukku area of Kollam, running since 1994 and known among locals for biryani and Malabar-style non-veg dishes alongside South Indian and Chinese pages. A reliable, affordable walk-in option for a biryani-and-porotta dinner in town.
insider_tip: Go for the chicken biryani; it is what regulars order. A casual family-restaurant setting — cost for two runs around ₹500. Cash and UPI.
